                                             DREAM PROPERTIES - BUSINESS MANDATE

Agreement entered into by and between

_____________________________________________________

Hereafter referred to as __________________________________

And

______________________________________________________________________________________

Hereafter referred to as “the Seller”

BUSINESS

The Seller wishes to sell the business trading as ________________________________________ at ___________________________________________, Knysna, hereafter referred to as “the Business”, on the material terms and conditions set out below.

from the date of signature hereof until 24h00 on _____________________, to sell the business, on the following terms or such other terms as I may approve in writing:

CONDITIONS OF SALE

The purchase price is R____________________________________(_______________________

______________________________________________________________________________), exclusive of value added tax, or such lower amount as the Seller may be prepared to accept.

The purchase price in clause 3.1 excludes the value of trading stock on hand, which shall be sold to the purchaser at cost, and also excludes any creditors or debtors of the Seller.

The purchase price is payable in cash against transfer of the Business to a purchaser and a purchaser shall be required to pay a deposit and/or provide acceptable guarantees for payment of the purchase price, upon conclusion of a sale agreement.

MANDATE BROKER

The Seller herby gives Dream Knysna (Pty) LTD an exclusive mandate to offer the Business for sale on the terms and conditions contained in clause 3 above.

Upon the sale of the Business to a purchaser introduced by Dream Knysna (Pty) LTD, the Seller shall pay commission to Dream Knysna (Pty) LTD equal to ten per cent (10%) of the purchase price in clause 3.1

Value added tax, if applicable, at the then current rate shall be added to the commission and paid by the Seller.

The commission shall be deemed to have been earned upon the signing of an agreement of sale by the Seller and the purchaser, and the fulfillment of all suspensive conditions contained in the agreement, and shall be payable upon the transfer of the Business.

OBLIGATIONS OF DREAM KNYSNA (PTY) LTD

Dream Knysna (Pty) LTD hereby undertakes to:

Treat all information given by the Seller to Dream Knysna (Pty) LTD and its authorised representatives in the strictest confidence and not to divulge any information to any potential purchaser who has not signed a confidentiality agreement;

Advertise the Business at Dream Knysna (Pty) LTD sole discretion and cost

THE SELLER’S WARRANTY

By signing this agreement the Seller warrants the accuracy of the information given by the Seller to Dream Knysna (Pty) LTD for purpose of disclosure to potential buyers.
